description: Archive a cloud coding-agent session: it leaves the working-set list (still viewable; resume/steer refused until unarchived) and any still-live sandbox is reclaimed at the next reaper tick without canceling an in-flight turn.
name: archive_agent_session

description: Mint a fresh attach ticket for a started cloud coding-agent session to (re)connect to its live or replayed conversation stream, without changing its lifecycle. Action 'read' for transcript replay (GET), 'turn' for live prompt execution (POST). Requires can_create for 'turn'.
name: attach_agent_session

description: Cancel a cloud coding-agent session and terminate its sandbox.
name: cancel_agent_session

description: Start a cloud coding-agent session on a repository. Returns the new session in phase creating; it does not return an attach ticket (call attach_agent_session for one).
name: create_agent_session

description: Permanently delete a finished cloud coding-agent session: its record and transcript are destroyed. Live sessions must be canceled first. Irreversible.
name: delete_agent_session

description: Read a workspace's agent environment: the sandbox network tier (registries = GitHub plus the built-in package registries for the whole session, the default; custom = registries plus customHosts; full = any public host over HTTP(S) through the bex egress proxy, with model providers blocked and no raw TCP or SSH), the custom hostnames, the default model, and whether the model is pinned by the platform model route.
name: get_agent_environment

description: Report a workspace's selectable agent profiles and GitHub/model-key readiness for composing a cloud coding-agent session; never returns model endpoints, templates, egress, or credentials.
name: get_agent_session_capabilities

description: Read the complete output of one tool call in a cloud coding-agent session. A transcript tool part flagged fullOutput: true stores only the head and tail of a long output inline (around a [bex: N chars clipped] marker); this returns the full text by field (output, errorText, terminal:<terminalId>), each capped at 1 MiB. Pass the session id, the part's turn and its toolCallId. Not found when no full copy was kept.
name: get_agent_session_tool_output

description: Read one page of a cloud coding-agent session's durable conversation transcript, seq-ordered: each part is a completed item (a UIMessage text, reasoning or dynamic-tool part; a data snapshot; or a start/finish chunk), partial when the live stream ended inside it (a later page may carry its complete copy under a new seq with the same turn and partIndex, which supersedes it; render parts in turn, partIndex order). Works for live, completed, and archived sessions; page by echoing nextAfterSeq as afterSeq until parts is empty.
name: get_agent_session_transcript

description: List cloud coding-agent sessions in a workspace: one filtered page, newest first. Defaults to the unarchived working set; archived selects false|true|all; cursor is the prior page's last session id (a shorter/empty page is the end).
name: list_agent_sessions

description: Resume a suspended cloud coding-agent session. Returns the session; it does not mint an attach ticket (call attach_agent_session for one).
name: resume_agent_session

description: Send a follow-up message to a cloud coding-agent session: it runs a new turn, re-dispatches the sandbox on the same branch and updates the same draft PR. The session must be steerable (state succeeded or failed, not archived or canceled).
name: send_agent_session_message

description: Alias of create_agent_session. Start a cloud coding-agent session on a repository; it does not return an attach ticket (call attach_agent_session for one).
name: spawn_agent_session

description: Alias of send_agent_session_message. Run a follow-up prompt turn on a cloud coding-agent session; it re-dispatches the sandbox on the same branch and updates the same draft PR.
name: steer_agent_session

description: Return an archived cloud coding-agent session to the working set, re-enabling resume/steer.
name: unarchive_agent_session

description: Update a workspace's agent environment (workspace admins only). Omitted fields keep their value: networkTier registries|custom|full; customHosts replaces the list (exact public hostnames, at most 32; [] clears); defaultModel "" returns to the provider default and cannot differ from a pinned model. The network tier and hosts apply from each session's next turn; the default model applies to sessions created afterwards.
name: update_agent_environment

description: Block until cloud coding-agent sessions settle, instead of polling get_agent_session in a loop. ids: 1-20 sessions. until: all (default) returns when every session has left state working, any when the first does. timeoutSeconds: 1-25 (default 25). Returns each session's id, state and outcome, the ids that settled, and timedOut. When timedOut is true the sessions are still working: call again.
name: wait_agent_sessions
